Gurugram Man Dies After Fall From Noida High-Rise; Police Investigate Financial Distress

A man from Gurugram died after falling from the 43rd floor of a high-rise building in Noida. Police are investigating the incident, with a focus on the possibility of financial distress as a motive. The man had reportedly checked into an Airbnb in Noida before the fall.
